description: Demo cast for the EEA Tokenization Starter Kit. Everyone here is fictional, including the institutions. Credentials carry statuses, codes and a hash, never personal data. No keys: locally the kit uses the public test keys of the local chain; on Sepolia it derives them from DEPLOYER_KEY.
